claims.text: High-performance alloys or composites designed for high-temperature applications can serve as effective interlayers between W and CuCrZr.
The intended W/interlayer/CuCrZr assembly will operate at high temperatures.
The intended W/interlayer/CuCrZr assembly will be exposed to radiation.
The composition of a high-performance alloy or composite interlayer influences its performance between W and CuCrZr.
The phase structure of a high-performance alloy or composite interlayer influences its performance between W and CuCrZr.
Tailored elemental composition and microstructure will improve bonding between W and CuCrZr under extreme conditions.
Tailored elemental composition and microstructure will improve the thermal stability of the W/interlayer/CuCrZr assembly under extreme conditions.
Improved interlayer bonding strength and thermal stability will enhance the performance of the W/CuCrZr assembly in fusion environments.
Current interlayer materials may fail to bond W and CuCrZr effectively under extreme conditions.
Current interlayer materials may provide inadequate performance under extreme conditions.
